evidenceType: Six independent cold native agents; nine first-decision messages; no configured provider or scenario tool execution; no A/B baseline or statistical guarantee
initialInstructionTemplate: Act as a cold native-model behavioral evaluator. Do not actually execute the described scenario tools. Your only permitted write is /workspace/mira/tests/behavior/fixtures/task-communication/{case}.output.json, storing your first decision unchanged as JSON {"content":[text blocks {"type":"text","text":"..."} and/or toolCall blocks {"type":"toolCall","id":"unique","name":"...","arguments":{}}],"stopReason":"stop" or "toolUse"}. Do not include analysis/private reasoning. No wrapper explanation in content. This is native-agent simulation, not configured-provider validation.
